guarantees.claim: When msg_mask_en_i is 1, msg_masked[i] is assigned msg[i] XOR msg_mask_permuted.
When msg_mask_en_i is 0, msg_masked[i] equals msg[i] (no mask).

uncertain_points.claim: All shares (i = 0..NumShares-1) use the same msg_mask_permuted signal without per-share indexing, which may violate threshold implementation rules requiring independent random masks per share.
uncertain_points.risk: Side-channel leakage not effectively prevented; the masking scheme could be broken if masks correlate across shares.

formal_sketch.consequent: All shares (i = 0..NumShares-1) use the same msg_mask_permuted signal without per-share indexing, which may violate threshold implementation rules requiring independent random masks per share

uncertain_points.claim: msg_mask_en_i is a combinational enable; glitches or transitions while msg is valid may generate unmasked or partially masked transient values on msg_masked, potentially leaking side-channel information.
uncertain_points.risk: Transient secret-dependent leakage via power/EM side-channels.

formal_sketch.consequent: msg_mask_en_i is a combinational enable; glitches or transitions while msg is valid may generate unmasked or partially masked transient values on msg_masked, potentially leaking side-channel information

uncertain_points.claim: msg_mask_permuted source must be verified to be a true random or cryptographically fresh mask, independent of msg and unpredictable; otherwise the masking provides no security.
uncertain_points.risk: Deterministic or predictable mask allows an attacker to remove masking.

formal_sketch.consequent: msg_mask_permuted source must be verified to be a true random or cryptographically fresh mask, independent of msg and unpredictable; otherwise the masking provides no security

security_implications: This chunk implements message masking for side-channel resistance in SHA-3 processing. msg_mask_permuted acts as a secret masking value shared across all shares, a probable violation of independent mask requirements. Transient glitches on msg_mask_en_i may unmask secret data, leaking critical key/material. The source and quality of msg_mask_permuted directly determine the effectiveness of the countermeasure.
